# Retrieve cached attraction results for Las Vegas
attractions_cache_key = "attractions_las_vegas"
attractions_results = get_results_from_cache(key=attractions_cache_key)

# Search for hotels in Las Vegas with specified criteria
hotel_cache_key = "hotels_las_vegas"
hotel_results = get_results_from_cache(key=hotel_cache_key)

# If hotel results are not in cache, search for hotels
if hotel_results is None:
    hotel_results = search_hotels(
        city="Las Vegas",
        checkin_date=["2025-08-03"],
        checkout_date=["2025-08-11"],
        num_people=5,
        stars=[3],
        budget=80
    )
    save_to_cache(key=hotel_cache_key, value=hotel_results)

# Filter hotels based on budget and star rating
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_results,
    budget=80,
    stars=[3]
)

# Sort hotels by price per night
sorted_hotels = sort_results(
    results=filtered_hotels,
    column="price_per_night",
    ascending=True
)

# Save sorted hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="sorted_hotels_las_vegas", value=sorted_hotels)

# Retrieve sorted hotel results from cache

# Display sorted hotel results
print("Here are some 3-star hotels in Las Vegas within your budget of $80 per night:")

    print(f"- {hotel['name']}: ${hotel['price_per_night']} per night, Rating: {hotel['rating']}")

# Filter attractions based on type

    prior_results=attraction_results,
    type=["Scenic"]
)
